title: Figure 6. A Toroidal Higher Dimension (wireframe torus)
description: Wireframe rendering of a torus representing a toroidal extra-dimensional topology. Caption: "Figure 6. A Toroidal Higher Dimension. This is one of the many possible topologies explored in higher dimensional theories." Accompanies sections "7.2 The Geometry of Extra Dimensions" (Calabi-Yau manifolds, anti-deSitter space) and "7.3 Higher Dimensions and Stabilization".
